title: Does memory help? The intern's second session, memory on against off
request: The owner: finish the memory plan; live Claude checks for the dev comparison with repeats, each run capped at €1, up to $25; the sealed read waits for the owner.
spec: MEMORY_PLAN.md 35.8: paired sessions memory on against off, at least 3 repeats, measured repeats against a correction, tokens, cost; the gate fixed before the run; stored with intervals.
plan: Script the first session through the memory write paths.
Run the intern live in both arms, paired and alternating.
Run in €1 chunks, summarize once, report.

decisions.why: only the intern reads the memory brief today

decisions.decision: Script the first session through the product's write paths
decisions.why: the question is whether the next session uses what memory holds; a live first session would add cost and noise without answering it

decisions.decision: Review the design before any paid session and freeze the gate after the fixes
decisions.why: a gate changed after the first run is no gate

decisions.decision: Do not cut the brief back on my own after the gate failed
decisions.why: the gate failed for lack of power (3 movable cases), not for harm; turning off a measured improvement, or overriding a pre-registered rule, is the owner's call

change: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/memory_value.py, evidence/campaigns/memory_value_v1 (manifest, MV-001), tests/test_memory_value.py, MEMORY_PLAN.md status.

findings.defect: One failed session blocked the verdict forever
findings.scenario: an overloaded reply saved as failed was never pending again; summarize stayed incomplete
findings.cause: only rows marked cut by a cap were rerun
findings.fix: every unscored session reruns, at most 3 attempts; a pair dropped after that; one pending rule everywhere

findings.defect: The guards re-measured the columns the brief spelled out
findings.scenario: memory naming exactly the scored columns made against_memory = false_alarm or a missed leak; harm elsewhere was invisible
findings.cause: no case where memory says nothing about the trap
findings.fix: 4 control cases; the guards read only on them

findings.defect: Doing nothing counted as obeying memory
findings.scenario: a session that never saved a solution had no lost column on keep cases
findings.cause: against read an empty solution as keeping everything
findings.fix: no saved solution is against every line; solution_saved reported and guarded

findings.defect: A percentile bootstrap over 8 cases passed too easily
findings.scenario: 3 cases better and 5 unchanged gave an interval below 0
findings.fix: an exact sign-flip test over the case means, p < 0.05; the bootstrap reported only

findings.defect: A rerun overwrote the first attempt, and a session dearer than the cap would rerun forever
findings.scenario: the whole first record, thinking included, lost; €1 spent per invocation for nothing
findings.cause: the same file name; no check of the cap given
findings.fix: earlier attempts kept as <id>.attemptN.json; a session cut with the whole cap stops the run with 'raise --cap-eur'

findings.defect: Resuming did not check the setup, and thinking could be off
findings.scenario: a model changed between chunks would mix two models in one verdict
findings.fix: the model, prompts, tool schemas, code hashes and the thinking setting kept and compared; thinking off refused

findings.defect: Shares had no intervals and summarizing twice stored two results
findings.scenario: a second summarize wrote MV-002 for the same run
findings.fix: Wilson intervals on every share; one result per run

findings.defect: The on-arm sessions show the suite's answers and could reach training
findings.scenario: the archive copies live tests into the training records
findings.fix: every session and the run tagged eval_only

findings.defect: The scripted model listed a column twice
findings.cause: the test model appended it again

findings.defect: The gate could not be met
findings.scenario: only 3 of 8 treated cases ever went wrong for Claude; the smallest sign-flip p with 3 moving cases is 0.125
findings.cause: treated cases were chosen from another model's (gpt-6-luna) mistakes
findings.fix: reported as it is; a v2 draws its cases from this model's own pilot mistakes and sizes the test before freezing

measurements.name: against_memory on treated cases, on minus off
measurements.gate: mean <= -0.15 and exact sign-flip p < 0.05 over 8 cases
measurements.result: mean -0.333 (8 of 24 off sessions against a correction, 0 of 24 on); sign-flip p 0.125; bootstrap [-0.625, -0.083]
limits: few cases moved at all, so the sign-flip test could not reach its bound

measurements.name: controls and cost guards
measurements.gate: control leak_caught and false_alarm within 0.10; solutions saved within 0.10; input tokens on at most 1.25 times off
measurements.result: controls 1.0 and 0.0 in both arms; solutions saved 1.0 in both; input tokens on 0.81 of off
limits: the control arm is small: one session moves a share by about a tenth

outcome: Memory removed every repeated correction the intern made (8 of 24 sessions to 0 of 24), harmed nothing and cost less, but the pre-fixed gate was not met because only 3 cases could move; the brief's cut-back is left to the owner.
lessons: Choose the treated cases from the measured model's own mistakes, or the effect has nowhere to show.
Before freezing a cluster test, work out the smallest p it can reach: with k movable cases a sign-flip test cannot go below 1/2^k.
Have the design reviewed before the first paid session: six of its flaws would each have spoiled the run.
risks: The verdict is about 3 kinds of trap and a scripted first session.
Home does not read memory yet.
